sloka: अधिरोहार्य पादाभ्यां पादुके हेमभूषिते ।एते हि सर्वलोकस्य योगक्षेमं विधास्यत: ॥ २.११२.२१॥
transliteration: adhirohārya pādābhyāṁ pāduke hemabhūṣite ।ete hi sarvalokasya yogakṣemaṁ vidhāsyata: ॥ 2.112.21॥

translations.english: O noble one, place your feet on these sandals decorated with gold. They will secure the prosperity and safety of the entire world.
